ilbaskin.heroSubtitle: Baskin is an inclusive sport that allows people with and without disabilities to play together on the same team.
ilbaskin.historyText: Baskin (inclusive basketball) was born in a school. Antonio Bodini and Fausto Capellini invented it. They wanted a sport where everyone has a real role, whatever their physical or cognitive abilities. Today the rules are looked after by the Italian Inclusive Sports Body (EISI) in Cremona. Thousands of people play it in Italy. On the jersey, the first digit of the number is the role, from 1 to 5. The other digits are the player's number.
ilbaskin.rolesIntro: Roles are assigned based on the player's motor abilities: use of hands, walking, running and balance. The sum of the roles of the players on court cannot exceed 23.

home.heroSubtitle: Inclusive sport for everyone. Let's train together, without distinctions.

values.title: Inclusion
values.body: The name "Karibu" in Swahili means welcome. Anyone who wants to play, whatever their ability, is welcome on our field.

values.title: Community
values.body: We are a family of over 80 people. Every training session is a moment of shared growth, on and off the field.

values.title: Commitment
values.body: Regional champions in 2018, with two teams in the Veneto championships 2025/2026. We always aim for improvement.

values.title: Territory
values.body: Born from an inclusion project by the Municipality of Montecchio Maggiore, we are a reference point for the whole Vicenza area.

storia.testo: Karibu was born from an inclusion project by the Municipality of Montecchio Maggiore, driven by the passion of 4 young women who loved sport and believed in its power to break down barriers.
Three years after its founding, Karibu won the regional championship title. A win for the whole group. Since then Karibu has been a well-known team across Veneto.
Like many sports organisations, we too came to a stop. But we didn't give up: training sessions became Zoom video calls, keeping the team spirit alive while waiting to get back on the field.

We reach 10 years of activity with over 80 members and organise the "Karibu Ten League", a celebratory tournament with 6 participating teams. A milestone that celebrates the growth of the association and opens a new era: that of the Montekki and the Kapuleti.

home.joinBody: Baskin is for everyone, whatever your ability. Write to us and we will tell you when and where to come to your first training session.
